text:
The first system can have several layers on it, not just from voice notes to a document.
They can integrate the software they use.

I have an appliance repair client who also sells appliances.
So they have POS.
They also have a Field Service Management.
Then for repairs under warranties, they have a hub where they submit it so they get paid for those warranty repairs.

So the process becomes a little bit more complicated.
But you can easily build a system around this which I did with one of my clients.

Using AI for the whole process will burn you a lot of tokens.
So you only use AI on processes where it requires judgement, then the rest can rely on a deterministic process through coding.
